name: Consensus
tagline: Consensus is an AI-powered academic search engine that extracts key findings directly from peer-reviewed papers. Instead of returning a list of links, it synthesises what the science actually says on a question and cites the specific studies. Researchers, students, and evidence-curious professionals use it to get reliable answers grounded in published literature.
